tools.name: get_root_folder_by_space
tools.title: Get DMS root folder of a given space
tools.description: Retrieves the root folder associated with a specific space.

space_id.description: space id for which the root folder is requested.

tools.name: get_documents_by_folder_id
tools.title: Get DMS files and/or folders under a given folder
tools.description: Retrieves the files (and/or folders) located under a folder stored in the DMS.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_root_folder_for_user
tools.title: Get DMS root personal folder
tools.description: Retrieves the root folder belonging to the currently authenticated user.

tools.name: get_document_by_id
tools.title: Get DMS folder or file by its id
tools.description: Fetches the metadata of a document given its unique identifier.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the document.

tools.name: get_document_content_by_id
tools.title: Get DMS file content
tools.description: Retrieves the textual or Markdown content of a document by its unique identifier.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the document.

tools.name: attach_document_to_content
tools.title: Link DMS file to a content
tools.description: Attach a file to a given content identified by its type (note, new, activity...) and its id

tools.name: update_document_description
tools.title: Update DMS file summary
tools.description: Updates the file summary. This will not change the content of the file.

tools.name: get_document_transcription_by_id
tools.title: Transcript an Audio DMS file
tools.description: Get the file transcription when it's an audio/video media content

tools.name: search_documents
tools.title: Search for files
tools.description: Searches for documents matching the specified query and optional filters.

space_id.description: Optional space identifier to restrict search scope.

parent_folder_id.description: Optional parent folder ID to filter results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

is_favorites.description: If true, restricts results to favorite documents.

tools.name: list_folder_children
tools.title: List DMS folder children
tools.description: Lists the direct child files and folders of a folder. Call get_root_folder_for_user, get_root_folder_by_space or get_documents_by_folder_id first to obtain a folder_id.

folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the folder to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_folder_breadcrumb
tools.title: Get DMS folder breadcrumb
tools.description: Returns the ancestor path (breadcrumb, from the drive root down to the folder) of a folder. Call get_documents_by_folder_id first to get a folder_id.

folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the folder.

tools.name: get_folder_tree
tools.title: Get DMS folder tree
tools.description: Returns the nested folder tree rooted at a folder. Call get_root_folder_for_user or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get a folder_id.

folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the root folder of the tree.

with_children.description: If true (default), include the child folders recursively.

tools.name: list_document_versions
tools.title: List DMS file versions
tools.description: Lists the versions of a versioned file, newest last. Call get_document_by_id or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get a document_id.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file.

tools.name: get_documents_size
tools.title: Get DMS drive size
tools.description: Returns the total storage size (in bytes) of a user or space drive. When owner_id is omitted, returns the size of the current user's personal drive.

owner_id.description: Identity id of the user or space whose drive size is requested. Optional; defaults to the current user.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create a DMS folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder under a parent folder. Call get_root_folder_for_user, get_root_folder_by_space or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get the parent_folder_id.

parent_folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the parent folder.

name.description: Name of the folder to create.

tools.name: create_document
tools.title: Create a text document in the DMS
tools.description: Creates a text-based document (markdown, HTML, plain text, CSV or JSON) from a content string authored in the chat. Use this to turn generated text into a real file in the Documents app. Call get_root_folder_for_user, get_root_folder_by_space or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get the parent_folder_id. For binary files (PDF, images, office files) use upload_document instead.

parent_folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the folder where the document is created.

name.description: The document file name. If no extension is given, one is appended based on the mime type (e.g. 'notes' with text/markdown becomes 'notes.md').

content.description: The text, markdown or HTML body of the document.

mime_type.description: Optional mime type (e.g. text/markdown, text/html, text/plain). Defaults from the name extension when omitted.

tools.name: upload_document
tools.title: Upload a file to the DMS
tools.description: Uploads a real or binary document (PDF, image, office file, etc.) into a folder. Use this when the user attaches a file or image in the conversation and asks to save it to the Documents app (the attachment is resolved automatically server-side), or from exactly one of a base64 payload or an http(s) URL (fetched server-side behind an SSRF guard). Call get_root_folder_for_user, get_root_folder_by_space or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get the parent_folder_id. For text/markdown/HTML authored in the chat, use create_document instead.

parent_folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the destination folder.

name.description: The document file name including its extension (e.g. 'report.pdf'). Mandatory with base64; optional with url or a chat attachment (the name is then derived from the source file).

base64.description: The file bytes encoded in base64. Provide exactly one source: the chat attachment, base64 or url.

url.description: An http(s) URL to download the file from. Provide exactly one source: the chat attachment, base64 or url.

attachment_object_type.description: Internal: object type of an existing platform attachment to upload (set automatically by the client from the file/image the user attached in the conversation — do not fill this yourself). Read as the current user, so its ACL is enforced.

attachment_object_id.description: Internal: object id of an existing platform attachment to upload (set automatically by the client — do not fill this yourself). Provide exactly one source: attachment_object_id, base64 or url.

tools.name: rename_document
tools.title: Rename a DMS file or folder
tools.description: Renames a file or folder. Call get_document_by_id or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get a document_id.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file or folder to rename.

tools.name: move_document
tools.title: Move a DMS file or folder
tools.description: Moves a file or folder into a destination folder. Call get_document_by_id or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get the document_id and the destination_folder_id.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file or folder to move.

destination_folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the destination folder.

conflict_action.description: Behaviour when a document with the same name exists in the destination. Defaults to 'rename'.

tools.name: copy_document
tools.title: Copy a DMS file or folder
tools.description: Copies a file or folder into a destination folder. Call get_document_by_id or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get the document_id and the destination_folder_id.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file or folder to copy.

destination_folder_id.description: The unique identifier of the destination folder.

tools.name: duplicate_document
tools.title: Duplicate a DMS file or folder
tools.description: Creates a copy of a file or folder in the same parent folder. Call get_document_by_id or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get a document_id.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file or folder to duplicate.

prefix.description: Optional prefix added to the duplicated name (e.g. 'Copy of').

tools.name: delete_document
tools.title: Delete a DMS file or folder
tools.description: Moves a file or folder to the trash. It can be restored with undo_delete_document. Call get_document_by_id or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get a document_id.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file or folder to delete.

tools.name: undo_delete_document
tools.title: Restore a deleted DMS document
tools.description: Cancels a previous delete_document and restores the document from the trash.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the previously deleted document.

tools.name: restore_document_version
tools.title: Restore a DMS file version
tools.description: Restores a previous version of a file as the current one. Call list_document_versions first to get a version_id.

version_id.description: The unique identifier of the version to restore.

tools.name: update_version_summary
tools.title: Update a DMS file version summary
tools.description: Updates the summary (change note) of a specific file version. Call list_document_versions first to get the version_id; the document_id is the file the version belongs to.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file the version belongs to.

version_id.description: The unique identifier of the version to update.

tools.name: set_document_visibility
tools.title: Set DMS document visibility
tools.description: Hides or shows a file or folder. Call get_document_by_id or get_documents_by_folder_id first to get a document_id.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the file or folder.

hidden.description: true to hide the document, false to make it visible.
